result.topic_en: Riemann treats a divergence-free, curl-free vector field (X1,X2,X3) as a gradient whose potential λ is harmonic; he then writes X as the curl of a vector potential u with source currents i, solves for u by a Newtonian potential integral, and sets up a variational principle for the magnetic actions.
